The cyclops smith {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops}, in Ab'Dendriel, will only work for you after you do him a favour: three {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts} for his 'girlfriend'. From then on he turns armours, shields, helmets and weapons into rare metals for addons and quests, and {item:Soul Orb|Soul Orbs} into {item:Infernal Bolt|Infernal Bolts}.
